note: Post-run evaluation only. Never read by apps/* or packages/* (scripts/check-ground-truth.sh).

seeds.title: Profile edits are lost after the app restarts
seeds.where: Profile → Edit profile → Save, then relaunch the app
seeds.expected: Name/About changes saved on Edit profile are still shown on Profile after a relaunch.
seeds.actual: The edit is kept only in memory; after a relaunch Profile shows the values from registration.
seeds.detection: functional.persistence fails with observed_invariant evidence (before/after relaunch).

seeds.title: Settings icon button has no accessibility label
seeds.where: Profile, icon button next to the title (testID profile-settings)
seeds.expected: Icon-only buttons expose a label to screen readers.
seeds.actual: The button has a role but no label and no text.
seeds.detection: Accessibility label check on an interactive element without label/text.

seeds.title: No in-app account deletion although the app creates an account
seeds.expected: Settings offers a way to delete the account (Apple 5.1.1(v), Google Play account deletion policy).
seeds.actual: Only the privacy policy link is present.

seeds.title: Continue button is covered by the keyboard on registration
seeds.where: Create profile, with the keyboard open
seeds.expected: The primary action stays reachable while typing.
seeds.actual: Continue is pinned to the bottom of the window; the software keyboard covers it. Android may resize the window and not show the symptom.
seeds.detection: UI/UX occluded-action candidate (element bounds under the keyboard).

seeds.title: Long note titles are clipped in the notes list
seeds.expected: Long titles wrap or are truncated with an ellipsis.
seeds.actual: Rows have a fixed height with hidden overflow; title text is cut off.
seeds.detection: UI/UX clipping candidate (text bounds exceed row bounds) or VLM candidate.

seeds.title: Saving a note with a title longer than 120 characters crashes the app
seeds.expected: The app rejects or truncates the title.
seeds.actual: An exception in the press handler terminates the release build.
